ov: حب حياتك (الإنجليزية: Love of Your Life) هو فيلم دراما رومانسية أمريكي صدر عام 2026، أخرجته ريتشل موريسون وكتبت جوليا كوكس سيناريو الفيلم. يشارك في بطولته مارغريت كوالي وآرون بيير وباتريك شوارزنيجر وغابرييل باسو وكاثرين كينر، وأنتجه رايان غوسلينغ وجيسي هندرسون. عرض الفيلم للمرة الأولى عالميا في مهرجان تورنتو السينمائي الدولي في 13 سبتمبر 2026. وطرحته استوديوهات أمازون إم جي إم في الولايات المتحدة في 7 أكتوبر، قبل إتاحته عالميا عبر أمازون برايم فيديو في 14 أكتوبر من العام نفسه.
plotEn:
At age twenty-six, Maya is a young nurse in Boston who is estranged from her single mother. She falls in love with Charlie after buying an antique drawer from him. Shortly after they begin dating, Maya introduces Charlie to Jason, her best friend since college. Jason is good-natured, but flaky and irresponsible, and frequently spends time with the couple. A year into their relationship, Charlie introduces Maya to his family on Cape Cod, and she quickly befriends his mother Ruth. During a monsoon on Charlie's thirtieth birthday, the couple marry in a small ceremony at their home.
At the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic, Maya becomes overworked and exhausted due to long hours and hospital shortages. Charlie remains supportive of her, but soon contracts COVID himself. At a high risk due to his asthma, he slowly succumbs to the virus and gets sent to the hospital; Maya, unable to get into the building, can only console him through FaceTime as he dies. After Charlie's death, Maya shuts herself in their home and withdraws from Ruth.
Three years later, Maya is thirty-one and living alone in Lisbon, where she and Charlie had wanted to travel together. Supporting herself through a telehealth job, she has grown despondent due to Charlie's death and spends her nights drinking and having one-night stands.
